C0350.title: Shen and Zheng Futures-Trading Embezzlement Case
keywords: Shen and Zheng futures-trading embezzlement case
C0350.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate's 47th batch of guiding cases disclosed that Shen and Zheng, staff members in the futures department of a state-owned company, used their positions to learn company futures strategies in advance and controlled personal accounts to trade against company accounts for profit. The two jointly gained more than 30 million yuan, and Shen separately gained more than 10 million yuan. Shanghai prosecutors indicted them in June 2021. The court convicted them of embezzlement, sentencing Shen to thirteen years and Zheng to five years in prison; the second-instance court upheld the judgment. The case clarifies that adding matched-trading links in futures transactions to appropriate state-owned assets can be assessed through abnormal trading points, account control, and actual gains when determining embezzlement facts and criminal amount.

references.title: Supreme People's Procuratorate 47th Batch of Guiding Cases
